candidate.event_recipe: P0=NYSE session before L0; L0=last session of month; F1..F3=first three sessions next month; F4=next session after F3

decision_and_fill.entry: decision after P0 close; fill L0 open
decision_and_fill.exit: decision after F3 close; fill F4 open
decision_and_fill.missing_tuple_policy: exclude event; never interpolate or use close

candidate.original_evidence: McConnell and Xu four-day turn-of-month CRSP daily-return observation
candidate.adaptation: SPY-only, four open-to-open intervals, next-supported-open execution

controls.passive: same SPY, 5% sleeve, first supported open through actual cell endpoint
controls.exposure_matched: for each event M0=F4, M1..M3=next three NYSE sessions, exit M4 open; fixed four open-to-open intervals
controls.v3: exact shared decision/fill timestamps only; otherwise NOT_COMPARABLE

isolated_diagnostic.cost_basis: current equity execution-cost model; hash-pinned before run

corporate_action_contract.native_mapping: timestamp=ex_date 00:00:00 UTC; value=decimal(rate) cash per share; preserve raw fields and raw_id
corporate_action_contract.entitlement: position held before ex-date receives dividend; purchase at ex-date open does not
corporate_action_contract.accounting_scope: retrospective realized-dividend/NAV cash accrual; calendar signal uses no CA forecast
corporate_action_contract.cash_funding: 95% cash sleeve; no protected-capital dividend funding required
corporate_action_contract.live_feed_pit_payment_truth: unproved; payable date is metadata only
corporate_action_contract.split_basis: canonical bars adjustment=split; pass prices unchanged; zero SPY split rows in local CA source; never apply split twice
corporate_action_contract.missing_payable_policy: retain missing metadata; do not invent payable or record dates; not used as entitlement timestamp
corporate_action_contract.source_semantics: Alpaca rate is cash per share; ex-date is first purchase date without entitlement

gates.rate_unit: PASS_BY_ALPACA_SCHEMA; recheck against retained source receipt before run
